meta.title: {site} — what are we eating today?
meta.description: Home recipes for breakfast, lunch, supper and drinks. Browse by day, plan your week, or roll the dice.

home.title: What are we eating today?
home.subtitle: Recipes for breakfast, every day of the week and drinks, made at home, with whatever you have.
home.browseSubtitle: Every day has its theme. Pick one and get cooking.
home.budgetText: Look for the low-budget tag: cheap dishes made from pantry staples.
home.eventsText: Birthday, wedding, Christmas… tell Chop how many guests and your budget, and get a full menu with costs.

breakfast.name: Breakfast
breakfast.theme: Eggs, breads, crêpes and sweet treats

dish.comingSoonText: This dish is on the menu, but its recipe hasn't been written yet.
dish.checkHint: Tap an ingredient to tick it off.

random.title: Roll the dice
random.subtitle: Can't decide? Let Chop pick for you.
random.empty: Nothing to pick from with these filters.

planner.title: Week planner
planner.subtitle: Breakfast, lunch and supper from Monday to Sunday. Reroll anything you don't like.
planner.modeDailyHint: Lunch and supper follow each day's theme.
planner.modeBatchHint: Not cooking every day? Pick the days you're free. Each time, you cook one dish that keeps well, and it's your main meal until the next cooking day. Breakfasts and light suppers are suggested, and long stretches get a snack day to take a break.
planner.freeDays: Which days are you free to cook?
planner.empty: Your week is empty. Let Chop fill it in.
planner.enoughFor: Make enough for {count, plural, one {# main meal} other {# main meals}}: {days}

search.title: Find a dish
search.results: {count, plural, =0 {No dishes found} one {# dish} other {# dishes}}

map.title: Treasure map
map.subtitle: Follow the trail one stop at a time. Tap a stop when it's done.
map.treasureText: You followed the whole map. Time to eat.
map.treasureHint: Reach the end of the trail to unlock it.

book.title: The cookbook
book.subtitle: Every dish, chapter by chapter. Turn the pages.
book.hint: Use the arrow keys or swipe to turn the pages
book.end: That's the whole book. Hungry yet?

markets.title: Shops & markets near you
markets.subtitle: Find markets, grocery stores, butchers and fishmongers around you to buy your ingredients.
markets.searchPlace: Or type a city or neighborhood
markets.privacy: Your location stays in your browser. It's only sent to OpenStreetMap to find shops nearby, and never saved.
markets.denied: We couldn't get your location. Type a city or neighborhood instead.
markets.error: The map service didn't answer. Please try again in a moment.
markets.found: {count, plural, =0 {No shops found} one {# place nearby} other {# places nearby}}
markets.none: Nothing found here. Try a bigger radius or another area.

kitchen.title: My kitchen
kitchen.subtitle: Your favorites, your own recipes, your photos and your shopping list. Everything stays on this device.
kitchen.noFavorites: No favorites yet. Tap the heart on any dish to keep it here.
kitchen.recipesNote: Only you can see these for now. Share one with a link.
kitchen.noRecipes: You haven't written a recipe yet. Add your own: it gets its own treasure map too.
kitchen.confirmDelete: Delete this recipe from this device?
kitchen.notFound: This recipe isn't on this device.
kitchen.badLink: This recipe link doesn't work. Ask for it to be shared again.

made.savedText: Your photo is saved on this device.
made.empty: No photos yet. Cook something, then tap "I made it!" on the recipe.

events.title: Plan an event
events.subtitle: Pick the occasion, the number of guests and your budget. Chop proposes a full menu with drinks, the quantities and an estimated cost.
events.none: Nothing here. Tap Add if you want some.
events.estimateNote: Prices are rough estimates in FCFA. Tap any price to change it; Chop remembers your prices.
